review.why: Designs recurring marketing jobs an agent runs on a schedule, each with a stop condition, saved state and human approval before spending or publishing.
review.summary: Defines nine parts of a loop (cadence, acts-when, purpose, skills, body, self-check, state, stop, output), a rule to match cadence to how fast the signal changes, and when not to loop. It points to a catalog of sixty loops, operator guides for SEO and outbound, guardrails and a template, and shows how to schedule with cron or agent features.
strengths: Separates how often a loop looks from when it acts
Saved state and a stop condition are mandatory, which prevents repeat alerts and runaway spend
Auto-drafting is allowed but publishing or spending needs a human checkpoint
cautions: Large: the catalog and guides are in eight files not read here
Needs a scheduler and connected tools to run
Sparse traffic makes weekly loops measure noise, as it warns
